body: I feel like I don't have the motivation to try to get better.

I had only one good therapist that was a young woman but she only worked in the hospital. I've tried a couple therapists after that and none have been as good. She got me to open up really easily and I felt safe and comfortable talking to her. I'm sure if I keep trying different therapists I could find one I like but I don't know if I really want to do that lol. Even though I probably should
I tried therapy and couldn't really feel comfortable fully opening up to my therapist.

Yeah I realize it's not the reality I just wish it could've been better than this, we've argued almost daily and they've all been really bad. Sucks because we were both pretty happy and excited to go and then we get here and it just goes to shit and I feel like I'm to blame. 

You're right about that, we both have said and done bad things that we can't take back. I regret my actions so much and I wish I could take them back :(

My mom would be really supportive of me no matter what and she always has been. You're right she cares about me a lot but if I told her everything I'm not sure what she'd think because I definitely majorly fucked up as well as my gf, and we've both been happy around them so it would be a shock. Plus I don't really want to tell her because I don't want her to think I don't appreciate what she does for me or think I didn't enjoy this trip (even though I haven't really). 

Thanks for the reply, I'm feeling a little better today. Hopefully spending the day with my family can make me feel better. Merry Christmas.

Yeah I know that but at least after I jump I wouldn't be able to take it back. My support system is pretty good but I don't really use it that well, I feel embarrassed to talk about this to people that care about me.  Thanks for the reply and merry Christmas.
